LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsUseRefreshedTextures: Swap Homesteader buildings, items, plants, and floors to the optional unique art pack. That pack is not in the Workshop download — copy Textures/HomesteaderRefresh from the GitHub repo into this mod folder. Original sprites always stay; this is off by default.
Takes effect the next time RimWorld starts.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsRefreshPackMissing: The optional unique art pack is not installed. Workshop and site zips ship original sprites only. To enable Use refreshed textures, copy Textures/HomesteaderRefresh from the GitHub repo into this mod folder and restart.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsRevealAllergiesTip: Tastes tab shows allergy names before discovery (eating the food or environmental exposure). For testing only.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsDevModeHint: Enable Development mode to show Homesteader developer options.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsSpoilageTriageTip: Colonists prefer the most-spoiled edible stack, and preserving bills take produce closest to turning. On by default.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsCoopEggInterval: Chicken coop egg interval (higher = fewer eggs)
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsEnableKatsTip: Rare Misc event when a finished 27 statue or monument is on the home map. Off disables it entirely.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsShowCoolingInspectTi: Root cellar, icehouse, and springhouse show the passive cool-storage ceiling in the inspect pane.
LanguageData.Homesteader_PantryDays: Days of food at current tables: {0} ({1} colonists)
LanguageData.Homesteader_PantryNextRotNone: Nothing in the pantry is close to turning.
LanguageData.Homesteader_PantryEmpty: No food in root cellars, icehouses, springhouses, preserves shelves, crates, or barrels.
LanguageData.Homesteader_PantryMakeBillFail: No work table for that recipe is built.

LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsSpoilageTriageBillsI: This RimWorld version blocked the bill-ingredient hook: preserving bills no longer take spoiling produce first. Eating still does.

LanguageData.Homesteader_MapleSeason_Dry: Sap run is nearly dry — wait for spring chill.

LanguageData.Homesteader_HarvestFestivalLetterText:
Autumn is here, and the colony gathers around the harvest maypole to celebrate the year's work.

The pantry holds {0} distinct preserves: {1}.

Stock more kinds of preserves for a bigger festival next year (3+ kinds for a full festival, 6+ for a bountiful one).
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_Open: An anomalous broadcast has locked onto your colony's 27 monument frequency. A brief heat dome is forming over the region, and several colonists report a short-lived fogginess — "brain rot," they call it.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_SilverTaken: Colony accounts show {0} silver diverted as a "Super Chat." Containment breach averted.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_KatsSpawned: The broadcast demanded {0} silver as a "Super Chat." The colony couldn't pay — and SCP-27272727 manifested as a hostile {1} named Kats at the map edge.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_NoSilver: The broadcast demanded {0} silver as a "Super Chat," but the colony had no silver to spare (and Kats failed to materialize).
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_ContainmentNote: Containment note: hydrate / medicate / masticate. Do not look away from the number.
LanguageData.Homesteader_TastesNotYetKnown: Not known yet. Tastes form once the colony feeds them.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsGameplayHeaderSave: Gameplay (this save). Saved with the colony; new games start from your latest choice.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsGameplayHeaderNewGam: Gameplay (defaults for new games). Each save keeps its own copy.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsLarderMoodTip: Colonists get a small mood boost when their map's cellars and pantries hold 3, 6 or 9 kinds of preserves.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsRainAwareWaterTip: Rain barrels and cisterns fill faster in the rain and stop collecting during a drought.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsBeesNeedBloomTip: Beehives only make honey and wax with at least four flowering crops, herbs or decorative plants nearby, in their growing season.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SpawnerNoBloom: Nothing in bloom nearby: the bees are idle.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SpawnerRain: Rain is filling it faster ({0} speed).
LanguageData.Homesteader_HarvestFestivalLetterFeast: Pumpkin pie and cider from the pantry made it a proper feast.
LanguageData.Homesteader_HarvestFestivalLetterTrader: Word of the festival is spreading. A trader caravan should arrive within a few days.
